patches.summary: Nil-guard for enrichWithStatus when c.Service returns (nil, nil)
Split apiErr vs notFoundErr on saved-route miss since store.Get returns (nil, nil) on miss
SQL injection guard: reject non-safe-ident resource and JSON-field names before splicing into ListIDs and ResolveByName
Capture AuthHeader() once per cacheKey call instead of invoking it twice
Default to embedded fixtures when --dataset is empty so installed binary works from any CWD
Embed default fixture dataset and add LoadDefaultFixtures helper
ClearTokens also clears LdbwsApiToken and AuthHeaderVal so `auth logout` is effective for non-OAuth auth modes
